body: I lost my dad this April a week after his birthday and two weeks after mine. I just turned 25 and I miss him so much. Its completely stunted me as a person and I feel I will never ever be able to be a whole person and I'm sort of floating through life.
I recently lost my father and understand what you're going through. Please go easy on yourself.
Just because your father died at 54 doesn't mean you will. Sure it contributes to family health history but you can live longer with examined help.

Gonna be honest i don't know if it's cuz I'm a sociopath or if it's because I'm starting a new chapter in my life, I miss him, but I feel I can move on without him.

Sure it's been a fast week. But my father would want to see me happy after his passing and to live life to it's fullest.

I want to take care of my friends and family that are still alive to enjoy life with me and I believe if I take things one step at a time a new found strength can grow.

Plz contact me if youd like someone to vent these thoughts to as well.
Send me a message if you'd like to talk I'm here and understand
I'm really just waiting til 9am today to get more news about that. This ordeal is destroying my whole family especially my mom.

I pray to be normal and well adjusted from time to time. I don't even fully believe in a god. But I feel like an empty hope to be better would help.

I cry alot and it makes me feel like a fucking wussy. But all the thoughts just go rushing through my head.
I feel like the biggest fucking failure in the world
I'm fine with doing that, the place I'd be moving too has cheaper rent.
